```{r setup, include=FALSE}
datatable_basic <- function(x, page_length = 10) {
  DT::datatable(
    x,
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "none",
    extensions = character(0),
    options = list(dom = "tp", pageLength = page_length, autoWidth = TRUE)
  )
}

q2_metadata <- readr::read_tsv(
  "benchmark_results/q20_ee22_both_full/downstream/cutadapt_paired/metadata.qiime.tsv",
  skip = 2,
  col_names = c(
    "SampleID", "No", "Subject", "Direction", "Region", "Cycle_1st",
    "Cycle_2nd", "PCR1_Group", "PCR2_Group", "PCR_Cycle_Group",
    "Qubit_ng_uL", "bp", "Mol_Conc_nM", "Normalized"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Sample_Type = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(Subject, stringr::regex("mock|zymo", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Mock",
      stringr::str_detect(Subject, stringr::regex("^(ASwab|CSwab|ETube)", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Control",
      TRUE ~ "True"
    ),
    Control_Type = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(Subject, stringr::regex("^ASwab", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Air swab",
      stringr::str_detect(Subject, stringr::regex("^CSwab", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Clean bench swab",
      stringr::str_detect(Subject, stringr::regex("^ETube", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Empty tube",
      Sample_Type == "Mock" ~ "Mock",
      TRUE ~ "Skin sample"
    ),
    Skin_Site = dplyr::case_when(
      Sample_Type == "True" & (is.na(Direction) | Direction %in% c("", "-")) ~ as.character(Region),
      Sample_Type == "True" ~ paste(Region, Direction),
      TRUE ~ as.character(Control_Type)
    ),
    Biological_Unit = dplyr::if_else(
      Sample_Type == "True",
      paste(Subject, Skin_Site, sep = " / "),
      as.character(Subject)
    ),
    Sample_Type = factor(Sample_Type, levels = c("Control", "True", "Mock")),
    Control_Type = factor(
      Control_Type,
      levels = c("Air swab", "Clean bench swab", "Empty tube", "Skin sample", "Mock")
    ),
    PCR_Cycle_Group = factor(
      PCR_Cycle_Group,
      levels = c(
        "PCR1_33__PCR2_8", "PCR1_33__PCR2_10",
        "PCR1_35__PCR2_8", "PCR1_35__PCR2_10"
      )
    )
  )

tax_clean <- function(ps) {
  tax <- data.frame(phyloseq::tax_table(ps), check.names = FALSE)
  tax[] <- lapply(tax, function(x) {
    x <- stringr::str_replace(as.character(x), "^[dkpcofgs]__", "")
    x[is.na(x) | x %in% c("", "__", "NA", "uncultured", "Unassigned")] <- ""
    x
  })

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(tax))) {
    if (tax$Species[i] != "") {
      tax$Species[i] <- stringr::str_replace_all(tax$Species[i], " ", "_")
    } else if (tax$Phylum[i] == "") {
      tax[i, 2:7] <- paste0(tax$Kingdom[i], "_k")
    } else if (tax$Class[i] == "") {
      tax[i, 3:7] <- paste0(tax$Phylum[i], "_p")
    } else if (tax$Order[i] == "") {
      tax[i, 4:7] <- paste0(tax$Class[i], "_c")
    } else if (tax$Family[i] == "") {
      tax[i, 5:7] <- paste0(tax$Order[i], "_o")
    } else if (tax$Genus[i] == "") {
      tax[i, 6:7] <- paste0(tax$Family[i], "_f")
    } else {
      tax$Species[i] <- paste0(tax$Genus[i], "_g")
    }
  }

  phyloseq::tax_table(ps) <- phyloseq::tax_table(as.matrix(tax))
  ps
}

make_phyloseq <- function(method, table_path, taxonomy_path) {
  count_matrix <- qiime2R::read_qza(table_path)[["data"]]
  taxonomy_input <- readr::read_tsv(taxonomy_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  taxonomy_split <- stringr::str_split_fixed(taxonomy_input$Taxon, ";", 8)
  taxonomy_matrix <- taxonomy_split[, 1:7, drop = FALSE]
  colnames(taxonomy_matrix) <- c(
    "Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"
  )
  rownames(taxonomy_matrix) <- taxonomy_input$`Feature ID`

  missing_taxonomy <- setdiff(rownames(count_matrix), rownames(taxonomy_matrix))
  if (length(missing_taxonomy) > 0) {
    missing_matrix <- matrix(
      "", nrow = length(missing_taxonomy), ncol = 7,
      dimnames = list(missing_taxonomy, colnames(taxonomy_matrix))
    )
    taxonomy_matrix <- rbind(taxonomy_matrix, missing_matrix)
  }

  metadata_frame <- q2_metadata |>
    dplyr::filter(SampleID %in% colnames(count_matrix)) |>
    dplyr::arrange(match(SampleID, colnames(count_matrix))) |>
    tibble::column_to_rownames("SampleID") |>
    data.frame(check.names = FALSE)
  count_matrix <- count_matrix[, rownames(metadata_frame), drop = FALSE]
  taxonomy_matrix <- taxonomy_matrix[rownames(count_matrix), , drop = FALSE]

  phy_raw <- phyloseq::phyloseq(
    phyloseq::otu_table(count_matrix, taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
    phyloseq::tax_table(taxonomy_matrix),
    phyloseq::sample_data(metadata_frame)
  )
  phy_taxclean <- tax_clean(phy_raw)
  kingdom <- as.character(phyloseq::tax_table(phy_taxclean)[, "Kingdom"])
  phy_fungi <- phyloseq::prune_taxa(kingdom == "Fungi", phy_taxclean)
  phy_final <- phyloseq::prune_samples(phyloseq::sample_sums(phy_fungi) > 0, phy_fungi)
  phy_final <- phyloseq::prune_taxa(phyloseq::taxa_sums(phy_final) > 0, phy_final)

  audit <- tibble::tibble(
    Method = method,
    Stage = c(
      "Imported ASV table", "Taxonomy cleaned",
      "Kingdom == Fungi retained", "Zero-sum samples/taxa removed"
    ),
    Samples = as.integer(c(
      phyloseq::nsamples(phy_raw), phyloseq::nsamples(phy_taxclean),
      phyloseq::nsamples(phy_fungi), phyloseq::nsamples(phy_final)
    )),
    Taxa = as.integer(c(
      phyloseq::ntaxa(phy_raw), phyloseq::ntaxa(phy_taxclean),
      phyloseq::ntaxa(phy_fungi), phyloseq::ntaxa(phy_final)
    )),
    Total_Reads = as.numeric(c(
      sum(phyloseq::sample_sums(phy_raw)), sum(phyloseq::sample_sums(phy_taxclean)),
      sum(phyloseq::sample_sums(phy_fungi)), sum(phyloseq::sample_sums(phy_final))
    ))
  )

  list(raw = phy_raw, cleaned = phy_final, audit = audit)
}

cutadapt_result <- make_phyloseq(
  "Cutadapt",
  "benchmark_results/q20_ee22_both_full/dada2/cutadapt/paired/table.qza",
  "benchmark_results/q20_ee22_both_full/taxonomy/cutadapt/paired/unite_v10_99_full/taxonomy.tsv"
)
itsxpress_result <- make_phyloseq(
  "ITSxpress",
  "benchmark_results/q20_ee22_both_full/dada2/itsxpress/paired/table.qza",
  "benchmark_results/q20_ee22_both_full/taxonomy/itsxpress/paired/unite_v10_99_full/taxonomy.tsv"
)

phy_cutadapt <- cutadapt_result$cleaned
phy_itsxpress <- itsxpress_result$cleaned

dir.create("Phyloseq", showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(phy_cutadapt, "Phyloseq/phy_ITS2_cutadapt_q20_ee22_20261015.rds")
saveRDS(phy_itsxpress, "Phyloseq/phy_ITS2_itsxpress_q20_ee22_20261015.rds")

get_species_count <- function(ps) {
  otu <- as(phyloseq::otu_table(ps), "matrix")
  if (!phyloseq::taxa_are_rows(ps)) otu <- t(otu)
  tax <- data.frame(phyloseq::tax_table(ps), check.names = FALSE)
  species_label <- dplyr::case_when(
    tax$Species != "" ~ stringr::str_replace_all(tax$Species, "_", " "),
    tax$Genus != "" ~ paste0(tax$Genus, " sp."),
    tax$Family != "" ~ paste0(tax$Family, " (unclassified)"),
    TRUE ~ "Unclassified fungi"
  )
  rowsum(otu, group = species_label, reorder = FALSE)
}

cutadapt_species <- get_species_count(phy_cutadapt)
itsxpress_species <- get_species_count(phy_itsxpress)
```

# 1. Dataset

## 분석 범위

- 입력: `q20_ee22_both_full`의 Cutadapt paired-end 및 ITSxpress paired-end DADA2 feature table과 UNITE v10 99% taxonomy
- 비교 단위: 두 방법에 모두 존재하는 동일 SampleID 83개
- phyloseq level: ASV count, 7개 taxonomy rank 및 동일 metadata
- filtering: taxonomy 정리, `Kingdom == Fungi`, zero-sum sample/taxon 제거만 적용함
- abundance threshold, singleton removal, rarefaction 및 decontam은 적용하지 않음
- PCoA: non-rarefied Species count에 pseudocount 0.5와 CLR을 적용한 Aitchison distance 사용함
- 방법 효과: 동일 SampleID 내 paired permutation을 적용한 PERMANOVA와 `betadisper`로 평가함

## Sample별 read 및 ASV 비교

```{r sample-qc-data}
sample_qc <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(
    SampleID = phyloseq::sample_names(phy_cutadapt),
    Method = "Cutadapt",
    Read_Depth = as.numeric(phyloseq::sample_sums(phy_cutadapt)),
    Observed_ASV = as.integer(phyloseq::estimate_richness(phy_cutadapt, measures = "Observed")$Observed)
  ),
  tibble::tibble(
    SampleID = phyloseq::sample_names(phy_itsxpress),
    Method = "ITSxpress",
    Read_Depth = as.numeric(phyloseq::sample_sums(phy_itsxpress)),
    Observed_ASV = as.integer(phyloseq::estimate_richness(phy_itsxpress, measures = "Observed")$Observed)
  )
) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    q2_metadata |>
      dplyr::select(SampleID, Subject, Skin_Site, Sample_Type, Control_Type, PCR_Cycle_Group),
    by = "SampleID"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Method = factor(Method, levels = c("Cutadapt", "ITSxpress")))

sample_qc_wide <- sample_qc |>
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Method, Read_Depth, Observed_ASV) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Method, values_from = c(Read_Depth, Observed_ASV))

depth_summary <- sample_qc |>
  dplyr::group_by(Method, Sample_Type) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    N = as.integer(dplyr::n()),
    Min = as.integer(min(Read_Depth)),
    Max = as.integer(max(Read_Depth)),
    Median = round(stats::median(Read_Depth), 1),
    Mean = round(mean(Read_Depth), 1),
    SD = round(stats::sd(Read_Depth), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

paired_qc_test <- tibble::tibble(
  Metric = c("Read depth", "Observed ASV"),
  N_Pairs = as.integer(nrow(sample_qc_wide)),
  Median_Cutadapt = c(
    stats::median(sample_qc_wide$Read_Depth_Cutadapt),
    stats::median(sample_qc_wide$Observed_ASV_Cutadapt)
  ),
  Median_ITSxpress = c(
    stats::median(sample_qc_wide$Read_Depth_ITSxpress),
    stats::median(sample_qc_wide$Observed_ASV_ITSxpress)
  ),
  P_value = c(
    stats::wilcox.test(
      sample_qc_wide$Read_Depth_Cutadapt,
      sample_qc_wide$Read_Depth_ITSxpress,
      paired = TRUE,
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value,
    stats::wilcox.test(
      sample_qc_wide$Observed_ASV_Cutadapt,
      sample_qc_wide$Observed_ASV_ITSxpress,
      paired = TRUE,
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value
  )
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(P_adjust_BH = stats::p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH"))

datatable_basic(depth_summary, 10)
datatable_basic(paired_qc_test, 10) |>
  DT::formatRound(c("Median_Cutadapt", "Median_ITSxpress"), 1) |>
  DT::formatSignif(c("P_value", "P_adjust_BH"), 3)
```

# 3. Beta diversity

## Aitchison PCoA 및 paired method effect

```{r beta-data}
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(cutadapt_species), colnames(itsxpress_species))
all_species <- union(rownames(cutadapt_species), rownames(itsxpress_species))

align_species <- function(x, taxa, samples) {
  aligned <- matrix(0, nrow = length(taxa), ncol = length(samples), dimnames = list(taxa, samples))
  aligned[rownames(x), colnames(x)] <- x
  aligned
}

cutadapt_aligned <- align_species(cutadapt_species, all_species, common_samples)
itsxpress_aligned <- align_species(itsxpress_species, all_species, common_samples)

clr_transform <- function(sample_by_taxon) {
  logged <- log(sample_by_taxon + 0.5)
  logged - rowMeans(logged)
}

cutadapt_clr <- clr_transform(t(cutadapt_aligned))
itsxpress_clr <- clr_transform(t(itsxpress_aligned))
rownames(cutadapt_clr) <- paste("Cutadapt", rownames(cutadapt_clr), sep = "__")
rownames(itsxpress_clr) <- paste("ITSxpress", rownames(itsxpress_clr), sep = "__")
combined_clr <- rbind(cutadapt_clr, itsxpress_clr)

pcoa_meta <- tibble::tibble(RowID = rownames(combined_clr)) |>
  tidyr::separate(RowID, into = c("Method", "SampleID"), sep = "__", extra = "merge") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    q2_metadata |>
      dplyr::select(SampleID, Subject, Skin_Site, Sample_Type, Control_Type, PCR_Cycle_Group),
    by = "SampleID"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Method = factor(Method, levels = c("Cutadapt", "ITSxpress")),
    Shape_Group = dplyr::case_when(
      Sample_Type == "True" ~ as.character(Subject),
      Sample_Type == "Control" ~ as.character(Control_Type),
      TRUE ~ "Mock"
    ),
    Shape_Group = factor(
      Shape_Group,
      levels = c("Air swab", "Clean bench swab", "Empty tube", "KSY", "PYH", "Mock")
    )
  ) |>
  data.frame(check.names = FALSE)
rownames(pcoa_meta) <- rownames(combined_clr)

aitchison_distance <- stats::dist(combined_clr, method = "euclidean")
set.seed(42)
method_permanova <- vegan::adonis2(
  aitchison_distance ~ Method,
  data = pcoa_meta,
  permutations = 999,
  strata = pcoa_meta$SampleID
)
method_dispersion <- vegan::betadisper(aitchison_distance, pcoa_meta$Method)
set.seed(42)
method_dispersion_test <- vegan::permutest(method_dispersion, permutations = 999)

pcoa <- stats::cmdscale(aitchison_distance, k = 2, eig = TRUE, add = TRUE)
pcoa_variance <- pcoa$eig[pcoa$eig > 0] / sum(pcoa$eig[pcoa$eig > 0]) * 100
pcoa_score <- tibble::as_tibble(pcoa$points, rownames = "RowID") |>
  dplyr::rename(Axis1 = V1, Axis2 = V2) |>
  dplyr::left_join(tibble::rownames_to_column(pcoa_meta, "RowID"), by = "RowID")

cutadapt_ordination <- stats::cmdscale(stats::dist(cutadapt_clr), k = 2, eig = TRUE, add = TRUE)
itsxpress_ordination <- stats::cmdscale(stats::dist(itsxpress_clr), k = 2, eig = TRUE, add = TRUE)
set.seed(42)
procrustes_test <- vegan::protest(
  cutadapt_ordination$points,
  itsxpress_ordination$points,
  permutations = 999
)

beta_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  Distance = "Aitchison (Species CLR, pseudocount 0.5)",
  N_Samples = as.integer(length(common_samples)),
  PERMANOVA_R2 = as.numeric(method_permanova$R2[1]),
  PERMANOVA_P = as.numeric(method_permanova$`Pr(>F)`[1]),
  Betadisper_P = as.numeric(method_dispersion_test$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1]),
  Procrustes_Correlation = as.numeric(procrustes_test$t0),
  PROTEST_P = as.numeric(procrustes_test$signif)
)

datatable_basic(beta_summary, 10) |>
  DT::formatRound(c("PERMANOVA_R2", "Procrustes_Correlation"), 4) |>
  DT::formatSignif(c("PERMANOVA_P", "Betadisper_P", "PROTEST_P"), 3)
```

```{r beta-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
main_pcoa <- ggplot(
  pcoa_score,
  aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2, colour = Method, shape = Shape_Group)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
  geom_line(aes(group = SampleID), colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.82) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Method), linewidth = 0.7, linetype = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = method_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Air swab" = 0, "Clean bench swab" = 1, "Empty tube" = 2,
      "KSY" = 5, "PYH" = 6, "Mock" = 4
    ),
    drop = TRUE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Cutadapt vs ITSxpress — paired Aitchison PCoA",
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", round(pcoa_variance[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", round(pcoa_variance[2], 1), "%)"),
    colour = "Method",
    shape = "Control source / Skin subject"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

x_density <- cowplot::axis_canvas(main_pcoa, axis = "x") +
  geom_density(
    data = pcoa_score,
    aes(x = Axis1, fill = Method, colour = Method),
    alpha = 0.25,
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_colors) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = method_colors)

y_density <- cowplot::axis_canvas(main_pcoa, axis = "y", coord_flip = TRUE) +
  geom_density(
    data = pcoa_score,
    aes(x = Axis2, fill = Method, colour = Method),
    alpha = 0.25,
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_colors) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = method_colors) +
  coord_flip()

pcoa_density_plot <- main_pcoa |>
  cowplot::insert_xaxis_grob(x_density, grid::unit(0.75, "in"), position = "top") |>
  cowplot::insert_yaxis_grob(y_density, grid::unit(0.75, "in"), position = "right") |>
  cowplot::ggdraw()

ggsave(
  file.path(results_figure_dir, "02_aitchison_PCoA_paired_method_effect.png"),
  pcoa_density_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 200,
  bg = "white"
)
pcoa_density_plot
```

# 4. Taxonomic composition

## Species overlap 및 paired abundance difference

- Spearman plot의 각 점은 sample 또는 ASV가 아니라, 동일 Species label로 집계한 뒤 83개 sample의 relative abundance를 평균한 Species-level taxon임.
- 분홍색으로만 표시하던 주요 taxon은 RColorBrewer `Paired`와 `Dark2` 기반의 고정 색상을 적용하고 Species 이름을 직접 표시함.
- 표는 전체 Species overlap과 Top 14 Species의 paired abundance difference를 유지함.

```{r taxa-data}
species_relative_long <- function(count_matrix, method) {
  relative <- sweep(count_matrix, 2, colSums(count_matrix), "/")
  data.frame(t(relative), check.names = FALSE) |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-SampleID, names_to = "Species", values_to = "Relative_Abundance") |>
    dplyr::mutate(Method = method)
}

species_relative <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  species_relative_long(cutadapt_aligned, "Cutadapt"),
  species_relative_long(itsxpress_aligned, "ITSxpress")
) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    q2_metadata |>
      dplyr::select(SampleID, Subject, Skin_Site, Sample_Type, Control_Type, PCR_Cycle_Group),
    by = "SampleID"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Method = factor(Method, levels = c("Cutadapt", "ITSxpress")))

taxa_means <- species_relative |>
  dplyr::group_by(Method, Species) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Mean_Relative_Abundance = mean(Relative_Abundance), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Method,
    values_from = Mean_Relative_Abundance,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Combined_Mean = (Cutadapt + ITSxpress) / 2) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Combined_Mean))

top_species <- taxa_means |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 14) |>
  dplyr::pull(Species)

taxon_levels <- c(top_species, "Others")
taxon_palette <- c(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Paired"),
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Dark2")
)
taxon_colors <- stats::setNames(taxon_palette[seq_along(taxon_levels)], taxon_levels)

taxa_paired <- species_relative |>
  dplyr::filter(Species %in% top_species) |>
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Species, Method, Relative_Abundance) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Method, values_from = Relative_Abundance, values_fill = 0)

taxa_tests <- taxa_paired |>
  dplyr::group_by(Species) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    N_Pairs = as.integer(dplyr::n()),
    Mean_Cutadapt = mean(Cutadapt),
    Mean_ITSxpress = mean(ITSxpress),
    Mean_Difference_ITSxpress_minus_Cutadapt = mean(ITSxpress - Cutadapt),
    P_value = if (all(ITSxpress == Cutadapt)) {
      1
    } else {
      stats::wilcox.test(ITSxpress, Cutadapt, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)$p.value
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    P_adjust_BH = stats::p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH"),
    Significant = dplyr::case_when(
      P_adjust_BH < 0.001 ~ "***",
      P_adjust_BH < 0.01 ~ "**",
      P_adjust_BH < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(P_adjust_BH)

taxa_overlap <- tibble::tibble(
  Item = c("Cutadapt detected Species", "ITSxpress detected Species", "Shared Species", "Cutadapt only", "ITSxpress only"),
  N = as.integer(c(
    sum(rowSums(cutadapt_aligned) > 0),
    sum(rowSums(itsxpress_aligned) > 0),
    sum(rowSums(cutadapt_aligned) > 0 & rowSums(itsxpress_aligned) > 0),
    sum(rowSums(cutadapt_aligned) > 0 & rowSums(itsxpress_aligned) == 0),
    sum(rowSums(cutadapt_aligned) == 0 & rowSums(itsxpress_aligned) > 0)
  ))
)

datatable_basic(taxa_overlap, 10)
datatable_basic(taxa_tests, 14) |>
  DT::formatPercentage(
    c("Mean_Cutadapt", "Mean_ITSxpress", "Mean_Difference_ITSxpress_minus_Cutadapt"),
    2
  ) |>
  DT::formatSignif(c("P_value", "P_adjust_BH"), 3)
```

```{r taxa-scatter-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
taxa_scatter_data <- taxa_means |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Taxon_Display = dplyr::if_else(Species %in% top_species, Species, "Other taxa")
  )

scatter_colors <- c(taxon_colors[top_species], "Other taxa" = "grey75")

taxa_scatter_plot <- ggplot(
  taxa_scatter_data,
  aes(x = Cutadapt + 1e-6, y = ITSxpress + 1e-6, colour = Taxon_Display)
) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey55") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.78, size = 2.2) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = taxa_scatter_data |>
      dplyr::filter(Species %in% top_species),
    aes(label = Species),
    seed = 42,
    size = 3.1,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    box.padding = 0.45,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = scatter_colors, guide = "none") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "Species mean relative abundance (Spearman rho = ",
      round(stats::cor(taxa_means$Cutadapt, taxa_means$ITSxpress, method = "spearman"), 3),
      ")"
    ),
    subtitle = "Each point represents one Species-level taxon; Top 14 taxa are labelled",
    x = "Cutadapt mean relative abundance",
    y = "ITSxpress mean relative abundance"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(results_figure_dir, "03_species_paired_abundance.png"),
  taxa_scatter_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 200,
  bg = "white"
)
taxa_scatter_plot
```

## Sample별 Species composition

- 각 막대는 개별 SampleID 한 개이며 sample 평균으로 합치지 않음.
- Cutadapt와 ITSxpress를 각각 독립된 큰 panel로 제시하고, 내부에서 Skin subject 또는 control source와 PCR cycle 조건을 분리함.
- 두 방법에 동일한 Species 순서와 RColorBrewer 기반 색상을 적용함.
- HTML에는 전체 그림을 축소한 preview를 표시하며, SampleID와 taxon을 확대해서 볼 수 있는 고해상도 원본은 `Results/01_Preprocessing`에 별도로 저장함.

```{r sample-composition-data}
sample_order <- q2_metadata |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Subject_Profile = dplyr::case_when(
      Sample_Type == "True" ~ as.character(Subject),
      Sample_Type == "Control" ~ as.character(Control_Type),
      TRUE ~ "Mock"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Subject_Profile, PCR_Cycle_Group, Skin_Site, SampleID) |>
  dplyr::pull(SampleID)

composition_sample <- species_relative |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Subject_Profile = dplyr::case_when(
      Sample_Type == "True" ~ as.character(Subject),
      Sample_Type == "Control" ~ as.character(Control_Type),
      TRUE ~ "Mock"
    ),
    Subject_Profile = factor(
      Subject_Profile,
      levels = c("Air swab", "Clean bench swab", "Empty tube", "KSY", "PYH", "Mock")
    ),
    Species = dplyr::if_else(Species %in% top_species, Species, "Others"),
    Species = factor(Species, levels = rev(taxon_levels)),
    SampleID = factor(SampleID, levels = sample_order)
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    Method, SampleID, Subject_Profile, PCR_Cycle_Group, Species
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Relative_Abundance = sum(Relative_Abundance), .groups = "drop")

draw_sample_composition <- function(method_name) {
  ggplot(
    composition_sample |>
      dplyr::filter(Method == method_name),
    aes(x = SampleID, y = Relative_Abundance, fill = Species)
  ) +
    geom_col(width = 0.9) +
    facet_wrap(
      vars(Subject_Profile, PCR_Cycle_Group),
      scales = "free_x",
      nrow = 1,
      drop = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = taxon_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(method_name, " — sample-level Species composition"),
      x = "SampleID",
      y = "Relative abundance (Species)",
      fill = "Species"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 6.5),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

cutadapt_composition_plot <- draw_sample_composition("Cutadapt")
itsxpress_composition_plot <- draw_sample_composition("ITSxpress")

ggsave(
  file.path(results_figure_dir, "04a_sample_species_composition_Cutadapt.png"),
  cutadapt_composition_plot,
  width = 42,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 200,
  bg = "white",
  limitsize = FALSE
)
ggsave(
  file.path(results_figure_dir, "04b_sample_species_composition_ITSxpress.png"),
  itsxpress_composition_plot,
  width = 42,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 200,
  bg = "white",
  limitsize = FALSE
)
```

## ASV sequence pattern 및 method 간 frequency 비교

- `Fungi_k`와 `Ascomycota_p`는 실제 Species명이 아니라 각각 Kingdom 또는 Phylum까지만 분류된 ASV에 부여한 fallback label임.
- 따라서 두 label 내부의 ASV 길이, adapter motif, prevalence와 abundance를 개별 서열 수준에서 다시 확인함.
- Cutadapt와 ITSxpress는 trimming 경계가 다르므로 완전 동일 서열뿐 아니라, 길이 100 bp 이상인 한쪽 ASV가 다른 쪽 ASV에 완전히 포함되는 exact-containment도 함께 평가함.
- 전체 재현 코드는 [05_unresolved_taxa_diagnostic.R](Results/01_Preprocessing/05_unresolved_taxa_diagnostic.R)에 저장함.

```{r unresolved-asv-diagnostic, include=FALSE}
diagnostic_env <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
sys.source(
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/05_unresolved_taxa_diagnostic.R",
  envir = diagnostic_env
)

unresolved_length_summary <- readr::read_csv(
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/05b_unresolved_taxa_length_summary.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
unresolved_length_tests <- readr::read_csv(
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/05c_unresolved_taxa_length_tests.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
nextera_correlations <- readr::read_csv(
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/05k_unresolved_taxa_all_nextera_metrics_correlations.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    Stratum %in% c("All samples", "True only"),
    Nextera_Metric %in% c("Cleanup_match_percent", "Raw_FastQC_percent")
  )
sequence_match_summary <- readr::read_csv(
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/05o_ASV_sequence_match_summary.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
unresolved_asv <- readr::read_csv(
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/05i_unresolved_taxa_all_ASVs_with_sequences.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
adapter_like_summary <- unresolved_asv |>
  dplyr::filter(Nextera_12mer_exact) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    N_ASV = dplyr::n(),
    Total_Reads = sum(Total_Reads),
    Max_Prevalence = max(Prevalence),
    Full_19mer_ASV = sum(Nextera_full_exact)
  )
```

### 미분류 ASV 길이와 Nextera motif

```{r unresolved-asv-tables}
datatable_basic(unresolved_length_summary, 10) |>
  DT::formatRound(c("Median_Length", "Q1_Length", "Q3_Length", "Median_GC", "Median_Entropy"), 2)
datatable_basic(unresolved_length_tests, 10) |>
  DT::formatSignif(c("P_Wilcoxon_vs_other_fungal", "P_adjust_BH"), 3)
```

- Cutadapt의 `Fungi_k`는 median `r unresolved_length_summary$Median_Length[unresolved_length_summary$Method == "Cutadapt" & unresolved_length_summary$Taxon_Group == "Fungi_k"]` bp로, 분류된 다른 fungal ASV의 median `r unresolved_length_summary$Median_Length[unresolved_length_summary$Method == "Cutadapt" & unresolved_length_summary$Taxon_Group == "Other_fungal_ASV"]` bp보다 현저히 짧음.
- Nextera 12-mer를 포함한 미분류 ASV는 `r adapter_like_summary$N_ASV`개, 합계 `r adapter_like_summary$Total_Reads` reads이며 모두 최대 prevalence `r adapter_like_summary$Max_Prevalence` sample임. 완전한 19-mer Nextera sequence를 포함한 ASV는 `r adapter_like_summary$Full_19mer_ASV`개임.
- 따라서 일부 짧은 ASV는 adapter-related artifact로 보이지만, 해당 reads 수가 작아 `Fungi_k`/`Ascomycota_p` 전체 abundance를 단독으로 설명하지는 못함.

```{r unresolved-asv-length-plot, echo=FALSE, out.width='85%'}
knitr::include_graphics("Results/01_Preprocessing/05g_unresolved_taxa_ASV_length.png")
```

### Nextera 비율과 미분류 taxon abundance

```{r nextera-correlation-table}
datatable_basic(nextera_correlations, 20) |>
  DT::formatRound("Spearman_rho", 3) |>
  DT::formatSignif(c("P_value", "P_adjust_BH"), 3)
```

```{r nextera-correlation-plot, echo=FALSE, out.width='90%'}
knitr::include_graphics("Results/01_Preprocessing/05h_unresolved_taxa_vs_nextera.png")
```

- 전체 sample에서는 Cutadapt `Fungi_k`와 raw/cleanup Nextera 지표가 양의 상관을 보이지만, True sample만 제한하면 BH 보정 후 유의하지 않음.
- ITSxpress에서는 같은 `Fungi_k` 관계가 반대 방향이므로, Nextera 비율이 특정 biological taxon을 직접 증가시킨다고 해석하기보다 sample type, 짧은 insert와 trimming method가 함께 만든 연관으로 해석함.

### Cutadapt–ITSxpress ASV sequence frequency

```{r sequence-match-summary}
datatable_basic(sequence_match_summary, 10) |>
  DT::formatSignif("Value", 4)
```

```{r sequence-frequency-plots, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6, out.width='49%'}
knitr::include_graphics(c(
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/05p_ASV_sequence_length_frequency.png",
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/05q_ASV_rank_abundance.png"
))
```

```{r matched-sequence-frequency-plot, echo=FALSE, out.width='72%'}
knitr::include_graphics("Results/01_Preprocessing/05r_matched_ASV_sequence_frequency.png")
```

- 완전 동일한 ASV sequence pair가 없는 것은 두 방법의 trimming 경계 차이와 일치함.
- ITSxpress ASV 중 100 bp 이상 exact-containment로 Cutadapt ASV에 대응되는 서열은 740개이며, 이들이 ITSxpress fungal read의 95.3%를 차지함.
- 대응 ASV의 전체 read frequency 순위상관은 Spearman rho 0.931로, 주요 서열의 abundance ordering은 두 방법에서 매우 유사함.

## PYH의 Aureobasidium 우점과 농도 관계

- 핵심 질문은 부위별 차이가 아니라, Cutadapt에서 `Aureobasidium tremulum`이 PYH library에 집중된 이유와 이것이 농도 의존적인지 여부임.
- 동일 SampleID의 Cutadapt–ITSxpress 차이와 함께, Cutadapt `A. tremulum` relative abundance 및 raw reads가 Qubit과 연관되는지 확인함.
- `Qubit_ng_uL`은 PCR 이후 library QC 값이므로 추출 직후 fungal biomass나 starting DNA 농도와 동일하게 해석하지 않음.
- KSY와 PYH는 각각 한 대상자이므로 아래 결과는 이 두 대상자의 기술적·생물학적 차이에 대한 기술적 분석이며 일반적인 subject effect 검정이 아님.
- 기존 계산의 전체 재현 코드는 [06_subject_method_discrepancy.R](Results/01_Preprocessing/06_subject_method_discrepancy.R)에 저장함.

```{r subject-method-diagnostic, include=FALSE}
subject_diagnostic_env <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
sys.source(
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/06_subject_method_discrepancy.R",
  envir = subject_diagnostic_env
)

subject_discrepancy_summary <- readr::read_csv(
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/06b_subject_discrepancy_summary.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
subject_discrepancy_tests <- readr::read_csv(
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/06c_subject_discrepancy_tests.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
qubit_discrepancy_correlations <- readr::read_csv(
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/06d_qubit_discrepancy_correlations.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
tremulum_correlations <- readr::read_csv(
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/06p_tremulum_correlations.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
taxa_method_direction <- readr::read_csv(
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/06o_taxa_method_difference_direction.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  dplyr::filter(Subject == "PYH") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(ITSxpress_minus_Cutadapt))) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 15)

subject_sample_profile <- readr::read_csv(
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/06a_paired_method_discrepancy_by_sample.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  dplyr::filter(Sample_Type == "True")

tremulum_cut_key <- rownames(cutadapt_species)[
  stringr::str_replace_all(rownames(cutadapt_species), "_", " ") ==
    "Aureobasidium tremulum"
]
tremulum_its_key <- rownames(itsxpress_species)[
  stringr::str_replace_all(rownames(itsxpress_species), "_", " ") ==
    "Aureobasidium tremulum"
]

tremulum_cut_reads <- if (length(tremulum_cut_key) == 1) {
  as.numeric(cutadapt_species[tremulum_cut_key, common_samples])
} else {
  rep(0, length(common_samples))
}
tremulum_its_reads <- if (length(tremulum_its_key) == 1) {
  as.numeric(itsxpress_species[tremulum_its_key, common_samples])
} else {
  rep(0, length(common_samples))
}

aureobasidium_sample <- tibble::tibble(
  SampleID = common_samples,
  Cutadapt_Aureobasidium_Reads = tremulum_cut_reads,
  Cutadapt_Aureobasidium_RA = tremulum_cut_reads /
    colSums(cutadapt_species[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]),
  ITSxpress_Aureobasidium_Reads = tremulum_its_reads,
  ITSxpress_Aureobasidium_RA = tremulum_its_reads /
    colSums(itsxpress_species[, common_samples, drop = FALSE])
) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    subject_sample_profile |>
      dplyr::select(
        SampleID, Subject, PCR_Cycle_Group, Qubit_ng_uL,
        Cutadapt_Reads, ITSxpress_Reads,
        Aitchison_Method_Distance, Nextera_percent,
        Cleanup_retained_percent
      ),
    by = "SampleID"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(Subject %in% c("KSY", "PYH"))

safe_spearman <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- stats::complete.cases(x, y)
  test <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
  tibble::tibble(N = sum(ok), Spearman_rho = unname(test$estimate), P_value = test$p.value)
}

aureobasidium_concentration_test <- purrr::map_dfr(
  c("KSY", "PYH"),
  function(subject_name) {
    dat <- aureobasidium_sample |>
      dplyr::filter(Subject == subject_name)
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      safe_spearman(dat$Cutadapt_Aureobasidium_RA, dat$Qubit_ng_uL) |>
        dplyr::mutate(Metric = "Relative abundance vs Qubit"),
      safe_spearman(dat$Cutadapt_Aureobasidium_Reads, dat$Qubit_ng_uL) |>
        dplyr::mutate(Metric = "Raw reads vs Qubit"),
      safe_spearman(dat$Cutadapt_Aureobasidium_RA, dat$Cutadapt_Reads) |>
        dplyr::mutate(Metric = "Relative abundance vs total fungal reads"),
      safe_spearman(dat$Cutadapt_Aureobasidium_RA, dat$Nextera_percent) |>
        dplyr::mutate(Metric = "Relative abundance vs Nextera percent")
    ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(Subject = subject_name, .before = 1)
  }
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(P_adjust_BH = p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH"))

aureobasidium_subject_summary <- aureobasidium_sample |>
  dplyr::group_by(Subject) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    N_Libraries = dplyr::n(),
    Detected_Libraries = sum(Cutadapt_Aureobasidium_Reads > 0),
    Mean_RA = mean(Cutadapt_Aureobasidium_RA),
    Median_RA = median(Cutadapt_Aureobasidium_RA),
    Median_Raw_Reads = median(Cutadapt_Aureobasidium_Reads),
    Median_Qubit = median(Qubit_ng_uL),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

aureobasidium_cycle_summary <- aureobasidium_sample |>
  dplyr::group_by(Subject, PCR_Cycle_Group) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    N = dplyr::n(),
    Median_RA = median(Cutadapt_Aureobasidium_RA),
    Median_Raw_Reads = median(Cutadapt_Aureobasidium_Reads),
    Median_Qubit = median(Qubit_ng_uL),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

readr::write_csv(
  aureobasidium_sample,
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/06q_aureobasidium_by_sample.csv"
)
readr::write_csv(
  aureobasidium_concentration_test,
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/06r_aureobasidium_concentration_tests.csv"
)
readr::write_csv(
  aureobasidium_cycle_summary,
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/06s_aureobasidium_cycle_summary.csv"
)
```

```{r subject-method-plots, echo=FALSE, out.width='49%'}
knitr::include_graphics(c(

  "Results/01_Preprocessing/06l_method_discrepancy_vs_qubit.png"
```

- PYH의 paired Aitchison distance median은 28.6으로 KSY의 20.4보다 크며, Bray distance도 각각 0.727과 0.441로 차이가 확인됨.
- ITSxpress/Cutadapt fungal read 회수율 median은 PYH 0.477, KSY 0.855로, PYH에서 ITSxpress 단계 후 보존되는 fungal reads가 더 적음.
- 전체 True sample에서 Qubit과 method distance의 상관은 rho 0.045, p = 0.712로 확인되어 낮은 library 농도가 전체 차이를 직접 설명하지 않음.

### Cutadapt–ITSxpress 차이에서 Aureobasidium의 기여

```{r subject-taxa-direction-table}
datatable_basic(taxa_method_direction, 15) |>
  DT::formatPercentage(
    c("Cutadapt", "ITSxpress", "ITSxpress_minus_Cutadapt"),
    2
  )
datatable_basic(tremulum_correlations, 10) |>
  DT::formatRound(
    c("Tremulum_vs_Aitchison_rho", "Tremulum_vs_ReadRecovery_rho", "Tremulum_vs_Qubit_rho"),
    3
  ) |>
  DT::formatSignif(
    c("Tremulum_vs_Aitchison_P", "Tremulum_vs_ReadRecovery_P", "Tremulum_vs_Qubit_P"),
    3
  )
```

```{r subject-taxa-contribution-plot, echo=FALSE, out.width='80%'}
knitr::include_graphics("Results/01_Preprocessing/06n_taxa_driving_PYH_method_difference.png")
```

- `Aureobasidium tremulum`은 KSY에서도 검출되지만 Cutadapt 평균 relative abundance가 약 0.95%인 반면, PYH에서는 52.3%로 매우 높음. 따라서 “PYH에서만 존재”라기보다 **PYH에서 우점**한 경우임.
- 이 taxon의 Cutadapt 대표 ASV는 303 bp, 387,357 reads, prevalence 64 sample로 짧은 low-frequency artifact가 아님.
- 해당 대표 ASV는 ITSxpress ASV와 100 bp 이상 exact-containment match가 없어 ITSxpress trimming/recognition 단계에서 보존되지 않았을 가능성이 큼.
- PYH 내부에서 Cutadapt `A. tremulum` relative abundance와 Qubit의 상관은 rho = 0.458, p = 0.005로 **양의 방향**임. 낮은 Qubit library일수록 이 taxon이 증가하는 패턴은 관찰되지 않음.
- PYH에서 `A. tremulum` abundance는 method distance와 양의 상관(rho = 0.630), ITSxpress/Cutadapt read 회수율과 음의 상관(rho = -0.649)을 보임. 이는 이 taxon이 많은 library에서 ITSxpress 결과와의 차이가 커진다는 뜻임.
- 다만 Qubit은 PCR 이후 전체 library 농도이며 fungal starting biomass의 직접 측정치가 아니므로, 양의 상관 역시 원인관계로 해석하지 않음.
- 현재 자료에서 가장 보수적인 결론은 **낮은 농도가 만든 artifact라는 근거는 없고**, 두 대상자 중 PYH의 실제 community에서 우점한 Cutadapt ASV가 ITSxpress에서 보존되지 않아 방법 차이가 확대됐다는 것임. 대상자가 각 1명이므로 host-specific biology와 batch를 분리할 수는 없음.

## ITS2 경계 trimming과 taxonomy resolution 검증

- Cutadapt의 `Fungi_k`/`Ascomycota_p` ASV 중 ITSxpress ASV가 100 bp 이상 정확히 내부에 포함되는 쌍을 대상으로 함.
- 정확 포함 시작·종료 좌표, 좌우 flanking 길이, ITSxpress 구간이 Cutadapt ASV에서 차지하는 비율과 taxonomy rank 변화를 계산함.
- `Fungi_sp`, `Pleosporales_sp`, `*_Incertae_sedis`처럼 이름만 더 긴 placeholder는 분류 개선으로 세지 않고, 실제로 정보가 추가된 가장 낮은 rank를 기준으로 판정함.
- 대표 쌍은 `Biostrings`/`DECIPHER`로 정렬하고 `ape`/`phangorn`의 GTR+Gamma maximum-likelihood tree로 보조 확인함.
- 전체 재현 코드는 [07_ITS2_boundary_taxonomy_analysis.R](Results/01_Preprocessing/07_ITS2_boundary_taxonomy_analysis.R)에 저장함.

```{r ITS2-boundary-analysis, include=FALSE}
boundary_env <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
sys.source(
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/07_ITS2_boundary_taxonomy_analysis.R",
  envir = boundary_env
)

boundary_summary <- readr::read_csv(
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/07b_ITS2_boundary_summary.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
boundary_pairs <- readr::read_csv(
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/07a_ITS2_boundary_containment_pairs.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
tree_fit_summary <- readr::read_csv(
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/07j_ITS2_tree_fit_summary.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

asco_boundary <- boundary_summary |>
  dplyr::filter(Cutadapt_Group == "Ascomycota_p")
fungi_boundary <- boundary_summary |>
  dplyr::filter(Cutadapt_Group == "Fungi_k")
asco_improved_read_percent <- 100 *
  asco_boundary$Improved_ASV_Cutadapt_Reads /
  asco_boundary$Cutadapt_Reads_in_Matched_ASVs
fungi_improved_read_percent <- 100 *
  fungi_boundary$Improved_ASV_Cutadapt_Reads /
  fungi_boundary$Cutadapt_Reads_in_Matched_ASVs
```

### 정확 포함 좌표와 flanking 길이

```{r ITS2-boundary-summary-table}
datatable_basic(boundary_summary, 10) |>
  DT::formatRound(
    c(
      "Improvement_Percent", "Median_Cutadapt_Length_bp",
      "Median_ITSxpress_Length_bp", "Median_Total_Flank_bp",
      "Median_ITS_Fraction_Percent"
    ),
    1
  ) |>
  DT::formatCurrency(
    c("Cutadapt_Reads_in_Matched_ASVs", "Improved_ASV_Cutadapt_Reads"),
    currency = "", digits = 0, interval = 3, mark = ","
  )
```

```{r ITS2-boundary-map, echo=FALSE, out.width='95%'}
knitr::include_graphics("Results/01_Preprocessing/07d_ITS2_boundary_exact_containment.png")
```

- `Ascomycota_p` matched ASV의 길이 중앙값은 Cutadapt `r round(asco_boundary$Median_Cutadapt_Length_bp)` bp, ITSxpress `r round(asco_boundary$Median_ITSxpress_Length_bp)` bp이며, 제거된 양쪽 flanking region의 합은 중앙값 `r round(asco_boundary$Median_Total_Flank_bp)` bp임.
- 즉 ITSxpress ASV는 대응 Cutadapt ASV 길이의 중앙값 `r round(asco_boundary$Median_ITS_Fraction_Percent, 1)`%를 차지하며, 그림에서 동일 core sequence가 Cutadapt 긴 ASV 내부에 정확히 위치함.
- 대표적인 동일 core sequence의 taxonomy는 `Ascomycota_p → Cladosporium`, `Ascomycota_p → Pleosporales`, `Ascomycota_p → Fusarium magnoliae-champaca`로 개선됨.

### 분류 rank 개선

```{r ITS2-boundary-improved-table}
boundary_pairs |>
  dplyr::filter(Classification_Improved) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Cutadapt_Total_Reads)) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Cutadapt_ASV = substr(Cutadapt_FeatureID, 1, 10),
    Cutadapt_Group,
    Cutadapt_Length_bp,
    ITSxpress_ASV = substr(ITSxpress_FeatureID, 1, 10),
    ITSxpress_Length_bp,
    Left_Flank_bp,
    Right_Flank_bp,
    ITSxpress_Deepest_Rank,
    ITSxpress_Deepest_Label,
    Cutadapt_Total_Reads,
    ITSxpress_Total_Reads
  ) |>
  datatable_basic(10) |>
  DT::formatCurrency(
    c("Cutadapt_Total_Reads", "ITSxpress_Total_Reads"),
    currency = "", digits = 0, interval = 3, mark = ","
  )
```

```{r ITS2-taxonomy-resolution-plot, echo=FALSE, out.width='82%'}
knitr::include_graphics("Results/01_Preprocessing/07e_ITS2_taxonomy_resolution_improvement.png")
```

- `Ascomycota_p`는 exact-containment 20개 중 9개(`r round(asco_boundary$Improvement_Percent, 1)`%)가 실제로 더 낮은 taxonomy rank까지 개선됨. 이 9개는 matched Cutadapt reads의 `r round(asco_improved_read_percent, 1)`%를 차지하여, abundance가 큰 `Ascomycota_p` 서열에서 ITS2 경계 정리가 분류에 유리했다는 근거가 강함.
- 반면 `Fungi_k`는 8개 중 1개(`r round(fungi_boundary$Improvement_Percent, 1)`%)만 `Capnodiales`까지 개선됐고, matched reads 중 `r round(fungi_improved_read_percent, 2)`%에 불과함. 따라서 이 기전은 일부 `Fungi_k`에도 존재하지만 `Fungi_k` 전체의 주된 설명은 아님.

### 대표 ASV alignment 및 maximum-likelihood tree

```{r ITS2-boundary-tree-summary}
datatable_basic(tree_fit_summary, 5) |>
  DT::formatRound("Log_Likelihood", 2)
```

```{r ITS2-boundary-tree, echo=FALSE, out.width='85%'}
knitr::include_graphics("Results/01_Preprocessing/07i_ITS2_representative_ML_tree.png")
```

- 대표 `r tree_fit_summary$Representative_Pairs`쌍의 Cutadapt full ASV와 ITSxpress internal ASV를 함께 정렬한 결과, 동일 core를 공유하는 쌍들이 가까운 위치에 놓이는 패턴을 확인함.
- 다만 full-length와 internal fragment가 혼재한 tree이므로 계통학적 관계나 새로운 taxonomic assignment의 독립적 증명으로 사용하지 않음. 이 분석의 직접 근거는 tree가 아니라 exact-containment 좌표와 동일 서열에 대한 UNITE taxonomy 변화임.
- 정확 포함 관계만으로 제거된 부분을 모두 ITS1·5.8S 또는 특정 flanking region이라고 확정할 수는 없음. 따라서 현재 결과는 **경계가 정리되지 않은 유효 fungal sequence가 classifier 입력에서 불리했을 가능성과 일치**하며, 전체 `Fungi_k`/`Ascomycota_p`가 불량 서열이었다는 뜻은 아님.

## 서열 길이 100 bp 이하의 짧은 ASV profile

- 여기서 `ASV 100 이하`는 누적 read 수가 아니라 대표 **서열 길이가 100 bp 이하인 ASV**를 뜻함.
- 이 기준은 filtering rule이 아니며, 짧은 서열이 Cutadapt와 ITSxpress에서 얼마나 생성되고 어느 sample과 taxonomy에 분포하는지 진단하기 위한 표시 기준임.
- ASV 수, 전체 read 기여도, 실제 길이 분포, abundance/prevalence, taxonomy 및 sample별 기여율을 함께 비교함.

```{r low-abundance-asv-data}
short_asv_length_threshold <- 100L

asv_profile_from_phyloseq <- function(ps, method) {
  otu <- as(phyloseq::otu_table(ps), "matrix")
  if (!phyloseq::taxa_are_rows(ps)) otu <- t(otu)
  tax <- data.frame(phyloseq::tax_table(ps), check.names = FALSE) |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("FeatureID")

  tibble::tibble(
    FeatureID = rownames(otu),
    Method = method,
    Total_Reads = as.numeric(rowSums(otu)),
    Prevalence = as.integer(rowSums(otu > 0)),
    Maximum_Sample_Reads = as.numeric(apply(otu, 1, max))
  ) |>
    dplyr::left_join(tax, by = "FeatureID") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Method = factor(Method, levels = c("Cutadapt", "ITSxpress")),
      Species_Label = stringr::str_replace_all(Species, "_", " ")
    )
}

all_asv_profile <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  asv_profile_from_phyloseq(phy_cutadapt, "Cutadapt"),
  asv_profile_from_phyloseq(phy_itsxpress, "ITSxpress")
) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    readr::read_csv(
      "Results/01_Preprocessing/05a_unresolved_taxa_ASV_metrics.csv",
      show_col_types = FALSE
    ) |>
      dplyr::transmute(
        Method, FeatureID, Length_bp, GC_percent,
        Nextera_full_exact, Nextera_12mer_exact
      ),
    by = c("Method", "FeatureID")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Short_ASV = !is.na(Length_bp) & Length_bp <= short_asv_length_threshold
  )

low_asv <- all_asv_profile |>
  dplyr::filter(Short_ASV) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Length_Bin = cut(
      Length_bp,
      breaks = c(0, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100),
      labels = c("≤50", "51–60", "61–70", "71–80", "81–90", "91–100"),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
    Abundance_Bin = dplyr::case_when(
      Total_Reads == 1 ~ "1",
      Total_Reads <= 5 ~ "2–5",
      Total_Reads <= 10 ~ "6–10",
      Total_Reads <= 100 ~ "11–100",
      Total_Reads <= 1000 ~ "101–1,000",
      TRUE ~ ">1,000"
    ),
    Abundance_Bin = factor(
      Abundance_Bin,
      levels = c("1", "2–5", "6–10", "11–100", "101–1,000", ">1,000")
    ),
    Prevalence_Bin = dplyr::case_when(
      Prevalence == 1 ~ "1 sample",
      Prevalence == 2 ~ "2 samples",
      Prevalence <= 5 ~ "3–5 samples",
      Prevalence <= 10 ~ "6–10 samples",
      TRUE ~ ">10 samples"
    ),
    Prevalence_Bin = factor(
      Prevalence_Bin,
      levels = c("1 sample", "2 samples", "3–5 samples", "6–10 samples", ">10 samples")
    )
  )

low_asv_summary <- all_asv_profile |>
  dplyr::group_by(Method) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    All_ASVs = dplyr::n(),
    Short_ASVs = sum(Short_ASV),
    Short_ASV_percent = 100 * mean(Short_ASV),
    All_Reads = sum(Total_Reads),
    Short_ASV_Reads = sum(Total_Reads[Short_ASV]),
    Short_read_percent = 100 * Short_ASV_Reads / All_Reads,
    Prevalence_1_Short_ASVs = sum(Short_ASV & Prevalence == 1),
    Median_short_ASV_reads = median(Total_Reads[Short_ASV]),
    Median_short_ASV_prevalence = median(Prevalence[Short_ASV]),
    Median_short_ASV_length = median(Length_bp[Short_ASV], na.rm = TRUE),
    Nextera_12mer_Short_ASVs = sum(Short_ASV & Nextera_12mer_exact, na.rm = TRUE),
    Nextera_12mer_Short_Reads = sum(
      Total_Reads[Short_ASV & !is.na(Nextera_12mer_exact) & Nextera_12mer_exact]
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

low_asv_bins <- low_asv |>
  dplyr::count(Method, Length_Bin, name = "N_ASV") |>
  dplyr::group_by(Method) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Fraction_of_low_ASVs = N_ASV / sum(N_ASV)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

low_asv_prevalence <- low_asv |>
  dplyr::count(Method, Prevalence_Bin, name = "N_ASV") |>
  dplyr::group_by(Method) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Fraction_of_low_ASVs = N_ASV / sum(N_ASV)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

low_taxon_order <- low_asv |>
  dplyr::group_by(Species_Label) |>
  dplyr::summarise(N_ASV = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::slice_max(N_ASV, n = 12, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::pull(Species_Label)

low_asv_taxonomy <- low_asv |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Taxon_Display = dplyr::if_else(
      Species_Label %in% low_taxon_order, Species_Label, "Others"
    ),
    Taxon_Display = factor(Taxon_Display, levels = c(low_taxon_order, "Others"))
  ) |>
  dplyr::count(Method, Taxon_Display, name = "N_ASV") |>
  dplyr::group_by(Method) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Fraction_of_low_ASVs = N_ASV / sum(N_ASV)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

low_taxon_colors <- stats::setNames(
  grDevices::colorRampPalette(c(
    RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Paired"),
    RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Dark2")
  ))(length(levels(low_asv_taxonomy$Taxon_Display))),
  levels(low_asv_taxonomy$Taxon_Display)
)

low_feature_ids <- split(
  as.character(low_asv$FeatureID),
  as.character(low_asv$Method)
)

sample_low_profile <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  list(Cutadapt = phy_cutadapt, ITSxpress = phy_itsxpress),
  function(ps, method) {
    otu <- as(phyloseq::otu_table(ps), "matrix")
    if (!phyloseq::taxa_are_rows(ps)) otu <- t(otu)
    ids <- intersect(rownames(otu), low_feature_ids[[method]])
    tibble::tibble(
      SampleID = colnames(otu),
      Method = method,
      Total_Fungal_Reads = as.numeric(colSums(otu)),
      Low_ASV_Reads = as.numeric(colSums(otu[ids, , drop = FALSE])),
      Low_ASV_Read_Fraction = Low_ASV_Reads / Total_Fungal_Reads,
      Detected_Low_ASVs = as.integer(colSums(otu[ids, , drop = FALSE] > 0))
    )
  }
) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    q2_metadata |>
      dplyr::select(SampleID, Subject, Sample_Type, Control_Type, Skin_Site, PCR_Cycle_Group),
    by = "SampleID"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Method = factor(Method, levels = c("Cutadapt", "ITSxpress")),
    Sample_Group = dplyr::case_when(
      Sample_Type == "Control" ~ as.character(Control_Type),
      Sample_Type == "True" ~ paste("Skin", Subject),
      TRUE ~ "Mock"
    ),
    Sample_Group = factor(
      Sample_Group,
      levels = c("Air swab", "Clean bench swab", "Empty tube", "Skin KSY", "Skin PYH", "Mock")
    )
  )

low_asv_sample_group <- sample_low_profile |>
  dplyr::group_by(Method, Sample_Group) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    N_Samples = dplyr::n(),
    Median_Low_Read_Fraction = median(Low_ASV_Read_Fraction),
    Q1_Low_Read_Fraction = quantile(Low_ASV_Read_Fraction, 0.25),
    Q3_Low_Read_Fraction = quantile(Low_ASV_Read_Fraction, 0.75),
    Median_Detected_Low_ASVs = median(Detected_Low_ASVs),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

readr::write_csv(low_asv_summary,
                 file.path(results_figure_dir, "08a_short_ASV_summary.csv"))
readr::write_csv(low_asv,
                 file.path(results_figure_dir, "08b_short_ASV_all_features.csv"))
readr::write_csv(low_asv_bins,
                 file.path(results_figure_dir, "08c_short_ASV_length_bins.csv"))
readr::write_csv(low_asv_taxonomy,
                 file.path(results_figure_dir, "08d_short_ASV_taxonomy_profile.csv"))
readr::write_csv(sample_low_profile,
                 file.path(results_figure_dir, "08e_short_ASV_sample_profile.csv"))
readr::write_csv(low_asv_sample_group,
                 file.path(results_figure_dir, "08f_short_ASV_sample_group_summary.csv"))
```

```{r low-abundance-asv-interpretation, results='asis'}
))
```

# 5. 결론

```{r conclusion, results='asis'}
cat(paste0(
  "- 동일한 ", length(common_samples), "개 sample에서 Cutadapt와 ITSxpress phyloseq object를 생성함.\n",
  "- 최종 fungal ASV는 Cutadapt ", phyloseq::ntaxa(phy_cutadapt),
  "개, ITSxpress ", phyloseq::ntaxa(phy_itsxpress), "개로 확인됨.\n",
  "- 총 fungal read는 Cutadapt ", scales::comma(sum(phyloseq::sample_sums(phy_cutadapt))),
  "개, ITSxpress ", scales::comma(sum(phyloseq::sample_sums(phy_itsxpress))), "개로 확인됨.\n",
  "- Paired Aitchison PERMANOVA의 method effect R2는 ",
  signif(beta_summary$PERMANOVA_R2, 3), ", p-value는 ",
  signif(beta_summary$PERMANOVA_P, 3), "로 확인됨.\n",
  "- Procrustes correlation은 ", signif(beta_summary$Procrustes_Correlation, 3),
  ", PROTEST p-value는 ", signif(beta_summary$PROTEST_P, 3), "로 확인됨.\n",
  "- 상위 14 Species 중 paired Wilcoxon BH-adjusted p < 0.05인 taxon은 ",
  sum(taxa_tests$P_adjust_BH < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "개로 확인됨."
))
```

# 6. 한계점 및 향후 분석 예정

- 현재 비교는 `q20_ee22_both_full` 한 parameter 조합에 한정됨.
- Cutadapt와 ITSxpress가 서로 다른 sequence variant를 생성하므로 ASV identity를 직접 일치시키지 않고 동일 taxonomy label의 Species count로 집계하여 비교함.
- 미분류 taxon은 가장 낮은 확인 rank 기반 label로 보완되어 database resolution의 영향을 받음.
- Aitchison PCoA는 rarefaction 없이 수행했으며, pseudocount 0.5 선택에 따른 sensitivity는 수행하지 않음.
- abundance threshold와 singleton removal을 적용하지 않아 low-abundance ASV가 phyloseq object에 유지됨.
- decontam method와 contaminant removal은 적용하지 않음.
- 현재 단계의 paired method test는 library-level 비교이며, Skin biological unit의 반복 PCR 구조에 대한 biological inference를 목적으로 하지 않음.

향후 분석 우선순위:

1. 본 보고서에서 생성한 두 phyloseq object를 입력으로 동일한 Basic analysis를 수행함.
2. Skin sample은 Subject × Site × PCR 구조를 유지하고, control은 source별로 분리하여 두 방법의 alpha, beta 및 taxa 결과를 비교함.
3. Batch balance와 decontam method·threshold가 승인된 이후 두 방법에서 contamination profile의 일관성을 평가함.
